metadata.description: Give your AI agent a real design engine — generate and edit designs and export print-ready PDFs over MCP. Powered by CE.SDK.

plugins.description: Local design engine for Claude Code from IMG.LY that lets Claude Code create, edit and export real, editable designs, including print-ready PDF with CMYK and bleed. Every design also opens in a built-in editor for hand edits. Local use is free, no account needed, runs on the user's machine.
plugins.name: codesign
